description: Crew Check: "do we all have the same mods?" for co-op Thunderstore games (Lethal Company, Valheim). Called without crewLists, it answers with the user's crew list: the Thunderstore name and version of each switched-on mod in their r2modman profile, to share with their crew. Called with the crewmates' pasted lists in crewLists, it compares them with the user's profile and names mods some players lack and mods on different versions. No network, read-only. Use when the user says "do we all have the same mods", "why can't my friend join" or "compare our modpacks".

crewLists.description: Crewmates' crew lists to compare with the user's profile, at most 16. Leave out to make the user's own list.

list.description: The crew list the crewmate shared, pasted as it is.

name.description: The crewmate's name, as the user calls them.

gameId.description: Canonical game ID of a Thunderstore game, e.g. 'lethalcompany' or 'valheim'. mw_detect_environment lists the games on this computer.

profileName.description: r2modman profile name. Defaults to the first profile alphabetically (typically 'Default').

name: mw_crew_check
title: Do we all have the same mods
